summary: Assigning a dictionary to Path.Command.Parameters from Python now replaces the whole parameter set (missing keys are removed, an empty dict clears all) instead of merging into the existing parameters; a dead assignment in dxf_post is removed with no change to its output.

pages.reason: App/CommandPyImp.cpp setParameters: Parameters assignment now replaces the std::map instead of merging keys; Command.pyi docstring states keys absent from the assigned dict are removed and advises copy-modify-assign for single-parameter edits
Path/Post/scripts/dxf_post.py parse(): removed assignment to a throwaway command copy that was never read; DXF output unchanged
Path/Post/scripts/dxf_post.py: dead-code removal only; no change to post-processor arguments, structure or output

meta.title: CAM: Make Command.Parameters assignment replace the parameter set
